summary: Re-review after revision: all three prior findings are resolved and verified. (2) The harmonic table's Bat B-point row now explicitly flags the stricter same-video phrasing with a pointer to references/evidence.md, restoring the skill's own 矛盾口徑照錄 policy at the table level. (3) Limitation 2 now names the largest unverified R-multiple claim (Triple Test 一对二十, VjSB-VRyxWI) alongside the other examples. The underlying content assessment stands from the first pass: 44/44 quote verifications passed (25 note-level quotes across 16 videos, 12 harmonic XABCD ratio checks confirming every number traces to 6_5DVT6uS9E rather than generic harmonic textbooks, 7 transcript-labeled quotes verified in data/transcripts/pK6S7CEqMAk.txt), zero fabrication or injection, contradiction tiers per profile 7.3 preserved (confluence 2-3 vs 3-5, RR 1:1/1:2/1:3, MA evolution 100-day to EMA50 to 21/50/200, breakout vs pullback), and DRY boundaries cleanly deferred to sibling skills. Only trivial residue remains; content risk is low.
